name: Onizukin
source:
One day the darling girl in the red hood (with a secret) skipped along the forest path when a wolf called out to her. "Oh mister wolf! What a big d*ck you have!"

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE076670.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
某天，一个藏着秘密、惹人怜爱的红帽少女蹦蹦跳跳地走在森林小路上，一头狼突然叫住了她。“哎呀，狼先生！你的肉棒可真大！”
